title: Epistemic Injustice in Language Models: An Audit of Pretraining Filters and Guardrails
reasoning: The paper uses the ethical and philosophical framework of 'Epistemic Injustice' to analyze and audit representational harms in language models. It evaluates how pretraining filters and guardrails affect marginalized identities, discussing social norms, pluralistic alignment, and the suppression of specific viewpoints as a form of injustice.
